card.name: Linking words before drug or baseline terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as from, with, of, to and 'and' that come just before a drug name, treatment start, or baseline value. Seen in label text on mean change from baseline, patients treated with a drug, and lists of IV fluids.

modes.label: Change from baseline
modes.description: The word 'from' after 'mean change' that leads into baseline or start of treatment.
modes.example: 2 mg/day 4 mg/day n=362 n=120 n=362 n=362 Mean Change<< from>> Baseline (kg) at Last Visit

modes.label: Treated with a drug
modes.description: Words like with, of, to or receiving that link a patient or time point to a drug or therapy.
modes.example: was increased slowly, as recommended above, syncope was reported in 0.4% (5/1,344) of patients treated<< with>> FANAPT, compared with 0

modes.label: Lists of fluids
modes.description: The word 'and' joining items in a list of injection solutions.
modes.example: 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection, USP 0.45% Sodium Chloride Injection, USP Lactated Ringer's<< and>> 5% Dextrose Injection,
